title: Voicemail: Greetings, Inboxes and Shared Boxes | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A caller who reaches nobody and hears silence rarely calls again, and a message that sits unheard is no better than a missed call. Voicemail in CrestApps for Orchard Core gives callers a greeting, sends each message to the right inbox, and lets a team claim, call back and mark a shared box's messages done, so nothing goes unheard.

In this video:
• Why voicemail, and where a message goes
• Recording or uploading your voicemail greeting
• Listening to your messages in the soft phone
• Whose inbox a voicemail goes to
• Working a queue's shared voicemail box: filter, claim, call back and mark done
• Use cases
